title: Matched one-board CFR i800 convergence control
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: For the exact board0/config/seed used by the i200 teacher, recomputing SRP and 3BP to i800 will materially reduce shallow-node strategy drift relative to i50-to-i200; if shallow drift remains high, CFR targets should not be confidence-weighted or scaled from i200.
material_change: Re-solve the exact As-7d-2c board0 from zero at b8/i800 for deployment_v55_srp_200bb and deployment_v55_3bp_200bb with seed 20260829, because the solver does not serialize regrets and --resume only skips completed boards. Compare deterministic sampled i200-to-i800 strategy drift by street/depth using the existing primary-source comparison code.
baseline: cfr-convergence-confidence-audit-20260830: i50-to-i200 mean TV 0.069 SRP and 0.080 3BP; 18.4%/21.9% of rows exceed TV 0.1, with 3BP shallow roots especially unstable.
source: cfr-convergence-confidence-audit-20260830 decision DEEPEN_ONE_BOARD_BEFORE_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHTING; exact i200 metadata in deployment-cfr8-deep-20260829.
notes: No learned policy is changed in this convergence control. Promotion criterion: i200-to-i800 shallow/root drift must be materially below i50-to-i200 on both SRP and 3BP before any convergence-weighted distillation. Solver --resume is intentionally not used because no regret-state continuation exists.

A prior attempt to invoke solve.ts with --help revealed that the CLI has no help mode and briefly launched legacy defaults. Exact PID 41468 was terminated at iter0/0 infosets; the default output directory contained no files afterward, so it contributes zero samples and no artifact.

SRP i800 completed from zero on the exact matched board/config/seed: 22,703,360 infosets, 623.6s solve, 693.3s including 1.257GB JSONL export. Starting matched 3BP i800 serially to avoid resource contention.

3BP i800 completed from zero: 3,673,670 infosets, 123.1s solve, 133.6s including 195.8MB export. Starting deterministic 0.002 sampled matched i200-to-i800 comparisons; all flop histories at depth <=1 are included regardless of sampling.

Both trees show consistent 36-39% shallow mean-TV reductions from i50->i200 to i200->i800, but absolute drift remains too high for confidence weighting: 7/8 root buckets in each tree still exceed TV 0.1. ALL-row drift is not a convergence estimator because i800 expands reachable support substantially.

result.summary: Exact matched board0 b8/i800 recomputes produced 22,703,360 SRP and 3,673,670 3BP infosets. Shallow mean TV fell by 36-39% versus the earlier i50-to-i200 interval, but root instability remained high (87.5% of buckets above TV 0.1 in both trees).
result.conclusion: More CFR iterations consistently reduce shallow drift, but i200 and even i800 are not sufficiently stable to justify checkpoint-drift confidence weights. The deeper artifacts are useful higher-fidelity teacher data; these measurements are strategy drift only, not exploitability.
result.next_step: Use the i800 board0 artifacts only as higher-fidelity supervision/control. Before scaling CFR breadth, test whether replacing the unstable i200 board0 targets with i800 targets yields a measurable learned-policy gain under a bounded matched distillation experiment, without treating drift as calibrated confidence.
